title: Greenhouse VPD Out-of-Range Hour
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plant:sensor sensor_type=vpd
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(vpd_kpa<0.6 OR vpd_kpa>1.4)) as out_of_range_hours by zone _time
| where out_of_range_hours>4
| sort - out_of_range_hours
description: Uses Greenhouse VPD sensors telemetry to monitor how many hours the vapor-pressure deficit sat outside the healthy range in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for microclimate issues that stunt growth or invite disease, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Greenhouse VPD sensors data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily VPD out-of-range count by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how many hours the vapor-pressure deficit sat outside the healthy range so you can spot microclimate issues that stunt growth or invite disease before it becomes annoying.
